blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos on Monday opened the gates of Malacañang to the public for a postbirthday celebration. During the “Salo-salo sa Palasyo” at the Kalayaan Grounds, Marcos’ supporters enjoyed festivities and conveyed their birthday greetings to the President, who turned 69 on Sunday.
